methods.name: WeightIt balance tables (fixed unweighted SD) and weight trimming (WeightIt::trim)
methods.reference: cobalt::bal.tab(binary = 'std', s.d.denom = 'pooled' | 'treated' | 'control'); WeightIt::trim(w, at, lower, treat)
quantities: SMD before/after (fixed unweighted SD, cobalt s.d.denom)
trimmed weights, caps, number changed, group sums, ESS, SMD after trimming (ATE upper and lower, ATT, ATC)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 300: 1e-8 relative (Tol::coef); number of changed weights exact

deviations.note: standardised (cobalt binary = 'std', MatchIt); cobalt's default reports the raw difference
refused; WeightIt maps at to max(at, 1 - at)

deviations.quantity: trim_quantile >= 1 as a count of top weights

methods.name: CBPS balance tables: SMD over the fixed unweighted SD
methods.reference: cobalt s.d.denom: sd(x[t1]), sqrt((var(x[t1]) + var(x[!t1])) / 2); binary sqrt(p (1 - p))
quantities: SMD denominators (pooled for ATE, treated for ATT)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 400: 1e-8 relative (Tol::coef) on SMD x SD against the weighted mean difference

methods.name: Stable balancing weights balance tables: SMD over the fixed unweighted SD
methods.reference: cobalt s.d.denom: treated SD (ATT), control SD (ATC), pooled (ATE); binary sqrt(p (1 - p))
quantities: SMD denominators (pooled for ATE, treated for ATT, control for ATC)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 300: 1e-8 relative (Tol::coef) on SMD x SD before weighting; 1e-12 absolute after exact balance

methods.name: twang: gbm Bernoulli boosting (depth 1 and 3) and the balance-optimal iteration
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 300: 1e-8 relative (Tol::coef); optimal iteration exact (runner-up gaps >= 2e-5)

deviations.note: global argmin over 1..n_trees; twang searches a 25-point grid then refines between neighbours (never better than the global minimum)
twang itself not installed; its criterion is computed in R from twang's definitions on gbm's path
